note: Bank of Saint Lucia's schedule of revised fees (effective 5 December 2025): personal chequing carries a monthly minimum service charge of 6 dollars; per-item and cheque stamp duty charges aren't modelled.

sources.title: Bank of Saint Lucia, Schedule of Revised Fees (effective December 5, 2025)
sources.said: BOSL SCHEDULE OF REVISED FEES: EFFECTIVE DECEMBER 5, 2025 ... PERSONAL CHEQUING Stamp Duty - Per Cheque $0.30 Monthly Minimum Service Charge $6.00
